objectives.name: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

objectiveRows.text: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

comments.body:
For anyone struggling with this quest - I don't know what causes it to bug but here's the work around:

[ul]
[li]When you pick up Fillion, if the quest task doesn't change to 'Carry him to safety', then you're bugged.[/li]
[li]Drop him (right-click the buff) and abandon the quest.[/li]
[li]Go back out to where the satchel is and pick it up again.[/li]
[li]Repeat the process and make sure the task changes appropriately before continuing.[/li]
[/ul]

If you forgot where you picked up the quest - the Bloodstained Satchel (Object #581822) it's just along the ridge there off the road - don't have exact coords, sorry.

For the phase where you have to carry him, you carry him outside the cave  -- when you get out go a little to the left and put him on his bedroll.   The location is here:

[code]/way 52.05, 69.37[/code]
